task: Connect the pure UTF-8 codec to Moss String values.
observation: Bootstrap, receiver completion, canonical docs, and minimized probes agree that String exposes code-point traversal but no UTF-8 bytes, scalar-to-String constructor, or byte-vector-to-String conversion.
impact: The complete pure codec layer is implementable, but the requested String interoperability layer cannot be honestly exported without a new language/runtime conversion boundary.

resolution.summary: Defer Layer B and specify the smallest explicit UTF-8/String conversion facility in the Team T architecture note.

suggestion: Add explicit owned String-to-UTF-8 bytes and strict UTF-8-bytes-to-String built-ins with typed malformed-input behavior.
